item.title: Financial Services Commission Appeals Tribunal established
item.description: The Ministry of Finance has established the Financial Services Commission Appeals Tribunal, which will be chaired by the Most Honourable Christopher Blackman, Retired Justice of Appeal. The Appeals Tribunal has been set up pursuant to Section 25 (4) of the Financial Services Commission Act. Retired Justice Blackman will be joined by Connie Smith and Nigel Bennett.
